description: Log a sleep dream to the user's private Dream Diary, in their own words, not log_event or log_moment. narrative is required; dreamed_at YYYY-MM-DD or a local time (omit for last night); title, mood, lucidity (none, partial, full), people_names, places, tags, notes.
